id: \bThe Gym battle here is a Double Battle. Be sure to go in with a strategy for it.
en: \bThe Gym battle here is a Double Battle. Be sure to go in with a strategy for it.
it: \bLa lotta in palestra qui è una Lotta in Doppio. Assicurati di entrare con una strategia adatta.

id: \bI moved all the way here to join the Space Center. Did you know some Pokémon come from space?
en: \bI moved all the way here to join the Space Center.  Did you know some Pokémon come from space?
it: \bMi sono trasferito fin qui per lavorare al Centro Spaziale.  Lo sapevi che alcuni Pokémon vengono dallo spazio?

id: \bSteven: Hello again. Come to visit my hometown, have you?
en: \bSteven: Hello again. Come to visit my hometown, have you?
it: \bRocco: Ciao di nuovo. Sei venuto a visitare la mia città natale, eh?

id: \bHow would you like a Beldum as a part of your team? You seem like the perfect person to train it.
en: \bHow would you like a Beldum as a part of your team? You seem like the perfect person to train it.
it: \bTi andrebbe di avere un Beldum in squadra? Mi sembri la persona perfetta per allenarlo.

id: \bHow is my Beldum doing? I'm sure you are treating it well.
en: \bHow is my Beldum doing? I'm sure you are treating it well.
it: \bCome sta il mio Beldum? Sono sicuro che lo tratti bene.

id: \bDon't you just love the sea? It just makes me so glad I live here.
en: \bDon't you just love the sea? It just makes me so glad I live here.
it: \bNon lo adori anche tu il mare? Mi rende così felice di vivere qui.
